# An effect's @update, run on every compiled target -- passEffect lowers it on
# all of them, android included, where DisposableEffect still brackets the
# lifetime and the report is the settle's -- and on the interpreter, which is
# what they are held to.
#
# testdata/effect_update.txtar is the code. The tests pin the three things a
# compiled settle could get wrong: a report per handler rather than per write
# (testOncePerHandler), the report before the rekey on a key that compares
# (testUpdateBeforeRekey, testEqualWrite), and none from a bracket the tree no
# longer holds (testGated). A test writing the instance itself settles after
# each statement, as the interpreter settles before each read
# (testHarnessWrite, testHarnessPush); on android the write and its settle run
# in one UI-thread block, or Compose rekeyed before @update ran.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

[gtk4] sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
[gtk4] stdout 'PASS'
[gtk4] ! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

struct Todo {
    title string
    done  bool = false
}

component saver ui.node {
    var todos list[Todo] = []
    var saved = 0
    var last = 0

    effect(on=todos, @update(t) {
        saved += 1
        last = t.length()
    })

    func add(title string) {
        todos.push(Todo{title=title})
    }

    func addTwo() {
        todos.push(Todo{title="a"})
        todos.push(Todo{title="b"})
    }

    func toggle(i int) {
        for var k, &todo = todos {
            if k == i {
                todo.done = !todo.done
            }
        }
    }

    func swapAll() {
        todos = [Todo{title="x"}, Todo{title="y"}, Todo{title="z"}]
    }

    ui.text #out(value="{saved}:{last}")
}

func testNotOnMount(t test.Test, c saver) {
    t.assert(c.out.value == "0:0")
}

func testPush(t test.Test, c saver) {
    c.add("a")
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1:1")
}

func testOncePerHandler(t test.Test, c saver) {
    c.addTwo()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1:2")
}

func testInsideAnElement(t test.Test, c saver) {
    c.add("a")
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1:1")
    c.toggle(0)
    t.assert(c.out.value == "2:1")
}

func testReplace(t test.Test, c saver) {
    c.swapAll()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1:3")
}

component scalar ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var log list[string] = []

    effect(
        on = n,
        @mount(k) { log.push("mount {k}") },
        @unmount(k) { log.push("unmount {k}") },
        @update(k) { log.push("update {k}") },
    )

    func set(v int) {
        n = v
    }

    ui.text #out(value=log.join(","))
}

func testUpdateBeforeRekey(t test.Test, c scalar) {
    c.set(1)
    t.assert(c.out.value == "mount 0,update 1,unmount 0,mount 1")
}

func testEqualWrite(t test.Test, c scalar) {
    c.set(0)
    t.assert(c.out.value == "mount 0,update 0")
}

component gated ui.node {
    var on = true
    var xs list[int] = []
    var n = 0

    if on {
        effect(on=xs, @update { n += 1 })
    }

    func add() {
        xs.push(1)
    }

    func off() {
        on = false
    }

    ui.text #out(value="{n}")
}

func testGated(t test.Test, c gated) {
    c.add()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1")
    c.off()
    c.add()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1")
}

ui.window(title="Saver") {
    saver
    scalar
    gated
}

func testHarnessWrite(t test.Test, c scalar) {
    c.n = 1
    t.assert(c.out.value == "mount 0,update 1,unmount 0,mount 1")
}

func testHarnessPush(t test.Test, c saver) {
    c.todos.push(Todo{title = "h"})
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1:1")
}
